verdicts.reason: B is the better resize, but neither is ready to ship. A breaks the CTA into four stacked lines of one or two words ('Shop / the / Summer / Line'). That reads as broken type, and the CTA runs nearly the full banner height. A's headline also splits awkwardly as 'Chase the / Light' and almost touches the top and bottom edges. B puts the CTA on a tidier two lines, but its headline ('Chase / the Light') still fills almost the whole height and squeezes the margins. A background dot sits behind 'Summer Line', and the small logo on the left feels lightweight next to the oversized headline.
